title: The transfer of Artinian and Cohen-Macaulay properties under module-finite extensions
summary: This paper deals with certain classes of modules under module-finite extensions. Let $\varphi: R\hookrightarrow S$ be a module-finite extension between commutative Noetherian local rings. We investigate the transfer of Artinian module structures and attached primes between $R$ and $S$. We clarify the behavior of local cohomology modules as well as certain structures of finitely generated $S$-modules under the restriction of scalars to $R$ via $\varphi$.
